exposure: Pregnancy multivitamin intake during the first trimester
outcome: Very preterm birth (before 32 weeks of gestation)
cohort: The study included 15,629 women from the Copenhagen Pregnancy Cohort who had data on first-trimester multivitamin intake and gave birth to singletons between October 2012 and October 2016.
finding: Pregnancy multivitamin intake during the first trimester was not associated with a decreased risk of preterm birth or very preterm birth in a high-income population.
